title: Suspend and resume an OTA (admin)
caption: Platform admin with MFA; every call audited.

steps.title: Suspend
steps.expect: `active → suspended`; `tenant.suspended` e-mail to owners; storefront and OTA API answer `TENANT_SUSPENDED` within 60 s; `billing` is refused here.

steps.title: Watch the job
steps.expect: `suspend` job `running` → `succeeded` when the OTA worker answers `tenant.suspended`.

steps.title: Resume
steps.expect: `suspended → active`; `tenant.resumed` e-mail; a billing suspension resumes only while the subscription is trialing/active.
